title: Get webpage anchors
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve existing webpage anchors within your TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace account. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/anchor/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by a TikTok One Creator Marketplace account.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/obtain-authorization-and-authentication-from-a-tto-creator-marketplace-account/v1.3).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | tto_tcm_account_id {Required} | string | The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace account.

To obtain the IDs of the accounts that you can access via `Access-Token`, use [/tto/oauth2/tcm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693478150146). | |anchor_ids|string[]|A list of anchor IDs.

Max size: 100.

If `anchor_ids` is not passed, all anchors within the TTO Creator Marketplace account will be returned.| |page|integer|Current page number.

Value range: ≥ 1.
Default value: 1.| |page_size|integer|Page size.

Value range: 1-50.
Default value: 10.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/tcm/anchor/get/?tto_tcm_account_id={{tto_tcm_account_id}}&page=1&page_size=50' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{access_token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #|anchors|object[]|A list of anchors.| ##|anchor_id|string|The ID of the anchor.| ##|status|string|The status of the anchor.

Enum value:
  • `DRAFT`: The anchor is in draft mode.
  • `CREATED`: The anchor has been created but has not been under review.
  • `IN_REVIEW`: The anchor is under review.
  • `APPROVED`: The anchor has passed review.
  • `REJECTED_BY_AUDIT`: The anchor was rejected during the review.
| ##|anchor_type|string|The type of anchor.

Enum value:
  • `WEB_ANCHOR`: Webpage anchor. A type of anchor through which you can display your website link above the creator's video description.
| ##|anchor_sub_type|string|Returned when `anchor_type` is `WEB_ANCHOR`. The specific type of webpage anchor.

Enum value:
  • `DESTINATION`: Web destination link. This type directs viewers to a web destination link that can be opened in TikTok. The anchor shows up both in the creator's video and the comment section.
  • `ECOMMERCE`: E-commerce template. This type directs viewers to an internal landing page where brands can add a coupon link. The anchor shows up only in the creator's video comment section.
  • `ENTERTAINMENT`: Entertainment template. This type directs viewers to an internal landing page where brands can add a video clip. The anchor shows up only in the creator's video comment section.
| ##|country_code|string|The code of the country or region. The app information from this country or region's app store will be used. This anchor won’t be available in other countries or regions.

To learn about the country or region that the code represents, see [Location code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737585867307010).| ##|call_to_action|object|Anchor link information.| ###|landing_page_url|string|The URL of the page that the anchor will redirect viewers to. This page shows more information about your product or service.| ###|ios_download_link|string|The iOS download link where people can download your app.

When `anchor_type` is `WEB_ANCHOR`, this field will be null.| ###|ios_deep_link|string|The iOS download deeplink where people can download your app.

When `anchor_type` is `WEB_ANCHOR`, this field will be null.| ###|android_download_link|string|The Android download link where people can download your app.

When `anchor_type` is `WEB_ANCHOR`, this field will be null.| ###|android_deep_link|string|The Android download deeplink where people can download your app.

When `anchor_type` is `WEB_ANCHOR`, this field will be null.| ##|anchor_title|string|The title of the anchor.| ##|anchor_name|string|The name of the anchor.| ##|anchor_sub_title|string|The title of the anchor, which is used to tell TikTok users what you're promoting about your product or service.

When `anchor_sub_type` is `DESTINATION`, this field will be null.| ##|thumbnail_url|string|The thumbnail URL for the anchor.| ##|coupon_link|object|This field returns a non-null value only when `anchor_sub_type` is `ECOMMERCE`.

Information about the coupon link that redirects users to a page with more information about your campaign discount.| ###|discount|number|Discount.

For instance, a `discount` of `5` means 5% off.| ###|coupon_url|string|Coupon URL.| ###|coupon_code|string|Coupon code.| ##|pixel_id|string|The ID of the pixel that measures and analyzes campaign performance.| ##|creator_preview_url|string|The preview URL of the anchor and landing page that you can use for mobile phone preview purposes.

The URL won't expire.| ##|advertiser_preview_url|string|The mobile preview URL of the anchor and landing page that you can use for desktop preview purposes.

The URL won't expire.

When `anchor_sub_type` is `DESTINATION`, this field will be null.| #|page_info|object|Pagination Information.| ##|page|number|Current page number.| ##|page_size|number|Current page size.| ##|total_number|number|Total number of results.| ##|total_page|number|Total number of pages.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "anchors": [ { "advertiser_preview_url": "{{advertiser_preview_url}}", "anchor_id": "{{anchor_id}}", "anchor_name": "{{anchor_name}}", "anchor_sub_title": "{{anchor_sub_title}}", "anchor_sub_type": "ENTERTAINMENT", "anchor_title": "{{anchor_title}}", "anchor_type": "WEB_ANCHOR", "call_to_action": { "android_deep_link": null, "android_download_link": null, "ios_deep_link": null, "ios_download_link": null, "landing_page_url": "{{landing_page_url}}" }, "country_code": "TW", "coupon_link": null, "creator_preview_url": "{{creator_preview_url}}", "pixel_id": null, "status": "IN_REVIEW", "thumbnail_url": "{{thumbnail_url}}" }, { "advertiser_preview_url": "{{advertiser_preview_url}}", "anchor_id": "{{anchor_id}}", "anchor_name": "{{anchor_name}}", "anchor_sub_title": "{{anchor_sub_title}}", "anchor_sub_type": "ECOMMERCE", "anchor_title": "{{anchor_title}}", "anchor_type": "WEB_ANCHOR", "call_to_action": { "android_deep_link": null, "android_download_link": null, "ios_deep_link": null, "ios_download_link": null, "landing_page_url": "{{landing_page_url}}" }, "country_code": "US", "coupon_link": { "coupon_code": "", "coupon_url": "", "discount": 5 }, "creator_preview_url": "{{creator_preview_url}}", "status": "IN_REVIEW", "thumbnail_url": "{{thumbnail_url}}" }, { "advertiser_preview_url": null, "anchor_id": "{{anchor_id}}", "anchor_name": "{{anchor_name}}", "anchor_sub_title": null, "anchor_sub_type": "DESTINATION", "anchor_title": "Watch Now", "anchor_type": "WEB_ANCHOR", "call_to_action": { "android_deep_link": null, "android_download_link": null, "ios_deep_link": null, "ios_download_link": null, "landing_page_url": "{{landing_page_url}}" }, "country_code": "CA", "coupon_link": null, "creator_preview_url": "{{creator_preview_url}}", "pixel_id": "7258197703320944642", "status": "IN_REVIEW", "thumbnail_url": "{{thumbnail_url}}" } ], "page_info": { "page": 1, "page_size": 50, "total_number": 3, "total_page": 1 } } } (/code) ```
